description: The bar chart illustrates the difference in performance between probing a single layer and probing the weighted sum of layers in multilingual BERT (mBERT) models. The x-axis represents the layers of the mBERT model, ranging from 0 to 12, with an additional category labeled 'concat' for the concatenation of all layers. The y-axis measures the percentage point difference, with values ranging from -10 to 0. The bars are grouped by layer, with each bar representing the difference in performance when probing that specific layer compared to the weighted sum of all layers. The bars are colored in shades of blue, with darker shades indicating larger negative values. The chart shows that probing individual layers generally results in a larger negative difference, indicating poorer performance, compared to probing the weighted sum of all layers. The 'concat' category shows the least negative difference, suggesting that probing the concatenation of all layers yields the best performance. The chart does not include any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
